units.rawText: Helios, Sector exit.
units.displayText: Helios, Sector exit.

spans.text: Helios, Sector exit.

units.rawText: Replacement complete... Uranus' memristor... back at Oasis, De Lacey checks up.
units.displayText: Replacement complete... Uranus' memristor... back at Oasis, De Lacey checks up.

spans.text: Replacement complete... Uranus' memristor... back at Oasis, De Lacey checks up.

units.rawText: Oasis' level of technology... more advanced than Helios... after De Lacey's adjustments... will be more flexible...
units.displayText: Oasis' level of technology... more advanced than Helios... after De Lacey's adjustments... will be more flexible...

spans.text: Oasis' level of technology... more advanced than Helios... after De Lacey's adjustments... will be more flexible...

units.rawText: Here are some gifts for everyone at the Oasis, don't you two...
units.displayText: Here are some gifts for everyone at the Oasis, don't you two...

spans.text: Here are some gifts for everyone at the Oasis, don't you two...

units.rawText: Hmph... looks like my concerns of snacking are unnecessary.
units.displayText: Hmph... looks like my concerns of snacking are unnecessary.

spans.text: Hmph... looks like my concerns of snacking are unnecessary.

units.rawText: Please... be careful.
units.displayText: Please... be careful.

spans.text: Please... be careful.

units.rawText: You two have much work remaining and need not accompany us far.
units.displayText: You two have much work remaining and need not accompany us far.

spans.text: You two have much work remaining and need not accompany us far.

units.rawText: Let's go. The Professor's waiting for us, we have no time to waste.
units.displayText: Let's go. The Professor's waiting for us, we have no time to waste.

spans.text: Let's go. The Professor's waiting for us, we have no time to waste.

units.rawText: Hehe, straightforward as always. Come by and have chocolates whenever you want!
units.displayText: Hehe, straightforward as always. Come by and have chocolates whenever you want!

spans.text: Hehe, straightforward as always. Come by and have chocolates whenever you want!

units.rawText: Penumbra secures Choco's parcel in his cloak, beginning the return journey. He waves to Zion and Choco by means of farewell, leaving a dashing silhouette.
units.displayText: Penumbra secures Choco's parcel in his cloak, beginning the return journey. He waves to Zion and Choco by means of farewell, leaving a dashing silhouette.

spans.text: Penumbra secures Choco's parcel in his cloak, beginning the return journey. He waves to Zion and Choco by means of farewell, leaving a dashing silhouette.

units.rawText: Uranus still looks back at the two in the distance longingly until their silhouettes become blurry and fade from view.
units.displayText: Uranus still looks back at the two in the distance longingly until their silhouettes become blurry and fade from view.

spans.text: Uranus still looks back at the two in the distance longingly until their silhouettes become blurry and fade from view.

units.rawText: Zzp—what a remarkable journey.
units.displayText: Zzp—what a remarkable journey.

spans.text: Zzp—what a remarkable journey.

units.rawText: If not for that little agent carrying things willy-nilly, we'd be back at the Oasis a few days earlier.
units.displayText: If not for that little agent carrying things willy-nilly, we'd be back at the Oasis a few days earlier.

spans.text: If not for that little agent carrying things willy-nilly, we'd be back at the Oasis a few days earlier.

units.rawText: But we've found the MR1207 unit we needed, and you won't have to end up a piece of scrap at the recycling station.
units.displayText: But we've found the MR1207 unit we needed, and you won't have to end up a piece of scrap at the recycling station.

spans.text: But we've found the MR1207 unit we needed, and you won't have to end up a piece of scrap at the recycling station.

units.rawText: My utmost gratitude, Mr. Penumbra. You have granted me a future that shall endure.
units.displayText: My utmost gratitude, Mr. Penumbra. You have granted me a future that shall endure.

spans.text: My utmost gratitude, Mr. Penumbra. You have granted me a future that shall endure.

units.rawText: Right, about...
units.displayText: Right, about...

spans.text: Right, about...

units.rawText: That thing, it's really sweet when you put it in your mouth, but the really rich kind of bitterness comes out about halfway through.
units.displayText: That thing, it's really sweet when you put it in your mouth, but the really rich kind of bitterness comes out about halfway through.

spans.text: That thing, it's really sweet when you put it in your mouth, but the really rich kind of bitterness comes out about halfway through.

units.rawText: There's a very mild sweetness of the milk on top of the bitterness. The crushed hazelnuts and peanuts change up the texture, and are crunchy. The leftover hazelnut skin sticks around for a bit in your mouth.
units.displayText: There's a very mild sweetness of the milk on top of the bitterness. The crushed hazelnuts and peanuts change up the texture, and are crunchy. The leftover hazelnut skin sticks around for a bit in your mouth.

spans.text: There's a very mild sweetness of the milk on top of the bitterness. The crushed hazelnuts and peanuts change up the texture, and are crunchy. The leftover hazelnut skin sticks around for a bit in your mouth.

units.rawText: The cocoa's bitterness helps balance the flavor, and you always feel like having another. I suppose that's one of the reasons it sells as well as it does.
units.displayText: The cocoa's bitterness helps balance the flavor, and you always feel like having another. I suppose that's one of the reasons it sells as well as it does.

spans.text: The cocoa's bitterness helps balance the flavor, and you always feel like having another. I suppose that's one of the reasons it sells as well as it does.

units.rawText: Mr. Penumbra, you speak of...
units.displayText: Mr. Penumbra, you speak of...

spans.text: Mr. Penumbra, you speak of...

units.rawText: Uh... you said you wanted to see just what the BOBOPUP chocolates taste like.
units.displayText: Uh... you said you wanted to see just what the BOBOPUP chocolates taste like.

spans.text: Uh... you said you wanted to see just what the BOBOPUP chocolates taste like.

units.rawText: ROBOPUP chocolates. Zzp—
units.displayText: ROBOPUP chocolates. Zzp—

spans.text: ROBOPUP chocolates. Zzp—

units.rawText: You are a meticulous and precise individual with a compassionate heart, though it would help if you were a little more honest.
units.displayText: You are a meticulous and precise individual with a compassionate heart, though it would help if you were a little more honest.

spans.text: You are a meticulous and precise individual with a compassionate heart, though it would help if you were a little more honest.

units.rawText: You have my thanks for going out of your way to remember their taste, and describe it to me in such detail.
units.displayText: You have my thanks for going out of your way to remember their taste, and describe it to me in such detail.

spans.text: You have my thanks for going out of your way to remember their taste, and describe it to me in such detail.

units.rawText: With your description, it is as if I have tasted it in all its exquisiteness.
units.displayText: With your description, it is as if I have tasted it in all its exquisiteness.

spans.text: With your description, it is as if I have tasted it in all its exquisiteness.

units.rawText: It's nothing... just that these types of things that eat away at the mind... are special, so I remembered them.
units.displayText: It's nothing... just that these types of things that eat away at the mind... are special, so I remembered them.

spans.text: It's nothing... just that these types of things that eat away at the mind... are special, so I remembered them.

units.rawText: Do you enjoy these special sensations?
units.displayText: Do you enjoy these special sensations?

spans.text: Do you enjoy these special sensations?

units.rawText: I don't hate them, I... I don't really like them either.
units.displayText: I don't hate them, I... I don't really like them either.

spans.text: I don't hate them, I... I don't really like them either.

units.rawText: Would you be willing to try one more recommendation of mine, then?
units.displayText: Would you be willing to try one more recommendation of mine, then?

spans.text: Would you be willing to try one more recommendation of mine, then?

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: If you don't mind, perhaps you would have a cup of this ale that has entranced me so.
units.displayText: If you don't mind, perhaps you would have a cup of this ale that has entranced me so.

spans.text: If you don't mind, perhaps you would have a cup of this ale that has entranced me so.

units.rawText: Its flavor has been described as a heavenly nocturne, and I pray that I have the good fortune of having you illustrate it to me.
units.displayText: Its flavor has been described as a heavenly nocturne, and I pray that I have the good fortune of having you illustrate it to me.

spans.text: Its flavor has been described as a heavenly nocturne, and I pray that I have the good fortune of having you illustrate it to me.

units.rawText: Uranus generously hands a can of the artisan brew in his hand to Penumbra. The thoroughly unguarded Doll cracks open the aluminum can, taking a healthy swig.
units.displayText: Uranus generously hands a can of the artisan brew in his hand to Penumbra. The thoroughly unguarded Doll cracks open the aluminum can, taking a healthy swig.

spans.text: Uranus generously hands a can of the artisan brew in his hand to Penumbra. The thoroughly unguarded Doll cracks open the aluminum can, taking a healthy swig.

units.rawText: First came the rich aroma of raspberry and cream... then...
units.displayText: First came the rich aroma of raspberry and cream... then...

spans.text: First came the rich aroma of raspberry and cream... then...

units.rawText: His face takes on the colors of black, red, and purple, his cheeks swollen like a hamster stowing away its food.
units.displayText: His face takes on the colors of black, red, and purple, his cheeks swollen like a hamster stowing away its food.

spans.text: His face takes on the colors of black, red, and purple, his cheeks swollen like a hamster stowing away its food.

units.rawText: <size=100>Pfft—</size>
units.displayText: Pfft—

spans.text: Pfft—

units.rawText: He expels all the beer in his mouth, choking and coughing on the remnant liquid.
units.displayText: He expels all the beer in his mouth, choking and coughing on the remnant liquid.

spans.text: He expels all the beer in his mouth, choking and coughing on the remnant liquid.

units.rawText: Cough, cough... gack...
units.displayText: Cough, cough... gack...

spans.text: Cough, cough... gack...

units.rawText: Liar... it's bitter... cough... not good... at all...
units.displayText: Liar... it's bitter... cough... not good... at all...

spans.text: Liar... it's bitter... cough... not good... at all...

units.rawText: Taking in the sight of Penumbra's resentful and undignified state, Uranus laughs heartily in his robotic voice.
units.displayText: Taking in the sight of Penumbra's resentful and undignified state, Uranus laughs heartily in his robotic voice.

spans.text: Taking in the sight of Penumbra's resentful and undignified state, Uranus laughs heartily in his robotic voice.

units.rawText: Zzp—zzz—
units.displayText: Zzp—zzz—

spans.text: Zzp—zzz—

units.rawText: This is the beer of the real world. Some who are chained to society use it to drown their sorrows. Perhaps its flavor is exactly that, the sorrows of adult life.
units.displayText: This is the beer of the real world. Some who are chained to society use it to drown their sorrows. Perhaps its flavor is exactly that, the sorrows of adult life.

spans.text: This is the beer of the real world. Some who are chained to society use it to drown their sorrows. Perhaps its flavor is exactly that, the sorrows of adult life.

units.rawText: Penumbra's reservations about the ale continue, marking an end to this eventful journey.
units.displayText: Penumbra's reservations about the ale continue, marking an end to this eventful journey.
